name: baml-smithers-workflows
description: Temporary Smithers workflow pack for the TEVM-grade TypeScript tooling upstream effort. Every file in .smithers/ is workflow scaffolding and is removed by the workflow's final cleanup task before the draft PR is finalized.
//: smthrs and zod are provided as node_modules symlinks into the local Smithers
working tree (/Users/williamcory/smithers), matching that repo's own
.smithers/node_modules layout. Run the workflow with the WORKING-TREE CLI:
never with a published Smithers build. Validate the graph before running:
Tests MUST run with .smithers as the cwd (bun run --cwd .smithers test, or
cd .smithers && bun run test): the prompts are *.mdx modules loaded by the
mdxPlugin preload wired in .smithers/bunfig.toml, and bunfig only applies
when bun starts in this directory. A bare `bun test ./.smithers/...` from
the repo root skips the preload and fails to import the workflow.
